subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When an assurance pass is invoked, it shall run in a fresh top-level execution context distinct from the implementing session and every sibling assurance pass, reading the exact proposal revision, task charter, codegate verdict, and governing design binding elements; sibling passes shall receive no other pass's session, candidates, findings, verdict, or output before their own terminal.
rationale: same-mind and cross-pass leakage defeat the independent scrutiny promised by critical assurance
fit_criterion: provenance shows distinct implementer/pass context identities and one identical reviewed revision; leakage fixtures for session, candidates, findings, verdict, and output are refused; pass-order changes do not alter the aggregate
